description: Address 5 review issues: webhook queue dequeue/ack/nack lifecycle gap with _in_flight tracking, wire _extract_durable_facts into heuristic fallback, cache ThreadPoolExecutor, nack returns bool, tighten commit SHA regex.
steps: Fix webhook queue: add _in_flight dict, dequeue moves items there, ack/nack operate on _in_flight (and persist _in_flight)
Cache ThreadPoolExecutor on the MemoryReflector instance instead of creating per call
Change nack() return type from None to bool (False when delivery_id not found)
Tighten commit SHA regex to minimum 8 hex chars with context requirement
Update tests to cover dequeue->ack and dequeue->nack lifecycle flows
Update tests for nack return value and updated heuristic fallback with hoist lines
acceptance_criteria: dequeue() moves item to _in_flight, ack()/nack() operate on _in_flight
_heuristic_fallback returns durable facts as hoist_lines (not empty list)
ThreadPoolExecutor is cached on the instance, not created per call
nack() returns bool (True if found, False otherwise)
Commit SHA regex uses minimum 8 hex chars
New tests cover the dequeue->ack/nack lifecycle
verification: eval "$(pyenv init -)" && cd /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany && python -m pytest tests/test_webhook_queue.py tests/test_memory_reflector.py -x -q
eval "$(pyenv init -)" && cd /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany && python -m pytest tests/ -q
findings: All 5 review issues fixed. Full suite: 2061 tests pass (7 new tests added for lifecycle coverage). The webhook queue now correctly tracks in-flight items, the heuristic fallback hoists durable facts, ThreadPoolExecutor is cached, nack returns bool, and SHA regex minimum is 8 chars.
